body.objective: Determine whether the certified rank-two Berger detector response survives the same-background second-order tangent cone and produces a genuinely relational memory record.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_DYNAMICAL_APPARATUS_PARENT and its full action hash, together with the certified Berger gravity-clock-Maxwell q1/q2, K_Berger generator, pairing and detector preparation modes.  Do not substitute the compact-product Z2 theorem: first construct the exact same-background Berger second-order integrability receiver for the two detector preparation directions and their finite sums in a declared correction class.  Compute the quadratic source, every stabilizer moment-map/Taub projection and every nonzero-shell resonant adjoint pairing that is defined on this carrier; if the required Berger cokernel or source map is absent, export the precise crosswalk contract and typed bridge/classical request.  On the resulting Z2_Berger locus, restrict the action-derived two-record response, compute its exact rank and kernel, and propagate the persistent memory pairs through the certified first-order transport.  Prove gauge/family covariance, causal dependence and independence from coordinate-only frequency choices.  Classify individual detectable modes and balanced combinations separately.  Export exact witnesses and a method-distinct verifier.
body.current_gate: same-background second-order integrability and relational memory of the rank-two detector response
body.forbid: no compact S1xS2 tangent cone identified with Berger modes; no passing linear rank called a nonlinear observable; no formal exponential-polynomial correction called bounded or stable; no coordinate-frequency ratio called redshift; no all-jet temporal-source verdict; no q3, branch, particle, positivity or quantum promotion without its own certificate
activates: observer-relational-redshift-promotion if a nonzero Z2_Berger memory response survives
or a scoped second-order detector obstruction with exact Taub/resonance witness
or a typed same-background bridge request if the integrability map is not defined
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER PROOF-FIRST PHYSICAL GATE.  The question is whether a dynamically prepared record survives the nonlinear constraints on the same Berger background.
notes: The action-derived apparatus parent certifies q1/q2, causal transport and a rank-two probe response, but not second-order extendibility or relational memory.
The compact-product finite-harmonic cone is a useful abstract criterion only; it has NO_CERTIFIED_MAP to Berger rows.
A missing same-background source/cokernel map is a legitimate bridge shortfall and must be made explicit rather than inferred.
